title: 3-Bedroom Minimalist House Design: Efficient Layout for Families
excerpt: Complete guide to designing a 3-bedroom minimalist house with efficient layout, space optimization tips, and smart storage solutions for Indonesian families.
content: **Designing a 3-bedroom minimalist house** has become the most popular choice for Indonesian families who want functional homes without sacrificing comfort. With three bedrooms, families with two children or those needing a separate workspace can enjoy the privacy and flexibility they need.

The main challenge in designing a 3-bedroom minimalist house is arranging the layout so that each room feels spacious and comfortable despite limited land area. This article will discuss various layout alternatives, space optimization tips, and storage solutions to help you create an ideal home for your family.
![3-bedroom minimalist house design with modern and efficient layout](/images/blog/desain-rumah-minimalis-3-kamar.webp)
## Understanding Your Family's Space Needs

Before determining the layout, it's important to understand the needs of each family member. A 3-bedroom minimalist house is typically built on 72-120 square meters of land with a building area of 60-100 square meters.
### Who Needs a 3-Bedroom House?
1. **Families with 2 children** - Each child has their own bedroom
2. **Families with elderly parents** - Special bedroom for parents living together
3. **Couples working from home** - One bedroom functions as a home office
4. **Families who frequently host guests** - Dedicated guest bedroom
5. **Property investors** - 3-bedroom homes have the highest rental and resale value
### Dividing Zones in Your Home

An efficient minimalist house divides the area into three main zones: public zone (living room, terrace), private zone (bedrooms, bathrooms), and service zone (kitchen, laundry area, storage). Proper zone placement determines comfortable circulation and residents' privacy.
## Comparison Table of 3-Bedroom Minimalist House Layouts
| Layout Type | Land Area | Building Area | Advantages | Disadvantages |
| Type 60 (6x10) | 72-84 m2 | 60 m2 | Budget friendly | Rooms tend to be small |
| Type 70 (7x10) | 84-100 m2 | 70 m2 | Balanced size and price | Needs storage optimization |
| Type 80 (8x10) | 100-120 m2 | 80 m2 | More spacious | Higher investment |
| Type 90 L-Shape | 108-130 m2 | 90 m2 | Good cross ventilation | Requires wider land |
| Type 100 Split | 120-150 m2 | 100 m2 | Very comfortable | Premium price |
## 3-Bedroom Minimalist House Layout Type 60
Type 60 is the most compact size for a 3-bedroom house. With a building area of 60 square meters, every inch must be maximized.
### Type 60 Room Arrangement
- **Master bedroom** - 3x3 meters (9 m2), equipped with built-in closet
- **Bedroom 2** - 2.5x3 meters (7.5 m2), sufficient for single bed and study desk
- **Bedroom 3** - 2.5x3 meters (7.5 m2), can serve as children's room or workspace
- **Living room + dining room** - 3x5 meters (15 m2), open-plan concept
- **Kitchen** - 2x3 meters (6 m2), I-shape or small L-shape layout
- **Bathroom** - 1.5x2 meters (3 m2), one shared bathroom
- **Terrace** - 2x3 meters (6 m2)
### Type 60 Optimization Tips

For type 60 houses, an open-plan concept between living room and dining room is essential. Avoid permanent partitions and use furniture as visual dividers. Choose multifunctional furniture such as sofa beds for guest rooms or folding dining tables that can be stored when not in use.

Vertical storage is the key. Use Sesoris [multi-purpose tiered shelves](/blog/rak-serbaguna) to take advantage of often-neglected wall space. Built-in closets from floor to ceiling in each bedroom will maximize storage capacity.
## 3-Bedroom Minimalist House Layout Type 70-80
Type 70-80 provides more flexibility in space division. At this size, you can have two bathrooms, a larger kitchen, and more comfortable circulation areas.
### Advantages of Type 70-80
- Master bedroom can have an en-suite bathroom
- Kitchen can use a more efficient L-shape layout
- Living room and dining room can be visually separated
- Circulation areas (corridors) are more spacious
- Allows for additional storage areas
### Layout Recommendations

For type 70-80, place the master bedroom at the back of the house for maximum privacy. The other two bedrooms can be positioned on opposite sides with the living room in the center. The kitchen should be at the back near the laundry area for efficient plumbing installation.

## Smart Storage Solutions for Every Room
### Master Bedroom

The master bedroom in a 3-bedroom minimalist house needs well-organized storage. Built-in closets with internal organizer systems are the best investment. Add drawers under the bed to store spare sheets, seasonal blankets, or rarely-used clothing.

Sesoris provides [storage cabinets](/blog/lemari-penyimpanan) and storage boxes specially designed to optimize closet space. With the right dividers and organizers, closet capacity can increase by up to 40%.
### Children's Bedroom

Children's bedrooms need flexible storage solutions because needs change as they grow. Use modular shelving systems with adjustable heights. Provide dedicated spaces for toys, books, and school supplies so children learn to organize on their own.
### Compact Kitchen

A 3-bedroom minimalist house kitchen is usually limited in size. Maximize storage with wall shelves, hanging utensil racks, and Sesoris [under-kitchen shelves](/blog/rak-kolong-dapur). Every corner of the kitchen must be utilized, including the area above cabinets and behind doors.
### Living Room and Common Areas

Choose living room furniture that has hidden storage functions. Coffee tables with drawers, TV consoles with closed shelves, and sofas with storage underneath the seating are smart choices to keep your living room tidy.
## Natural Ventilation and Lighting
### Cross Ventilation

A 3-bedroom minimalist house should be designed with good air circulation. Position windows facing each other to create natural cross ventilation. This is essential in Indonesia's tropical climate to reduce AC dependence and maintain indoor air quality.
### Skylight and Void

For houses squeezed between adjacent buildings, skylights or voids are effective natural lighting solutions. Place the void in the center of the house so light can spread to surrounding rooms. Void areas can also be turned into a mini indoor garden for air circulation.
### Ideal Window Sizes
- **Bedrooms** - Windows covering at least 10% of room floor area
- **Living room** - Large windows or sliding glass doors for spacious feel
- **Kitchen** - Window above kitchen set for cooking smoke ventilation
- **Bathroom** - Small window or exhaust fan for humidity control
## Efficient Building Materials
### Walls

For 3-bedroom minimalist houses, lightweight concrete blocks (hebel) are recommended over conventional red bricks. Lightweight blocks are faster to install, lighter load on foundations, and provide better heat insulation.
### Roof

Concrete flat roof or pitched roof with lightweight steel frames are popular choices. Concrete flat roof opens the possibility for future second-floor expansion, while pitched roofs with flat tiles provide a clean minimalist appearance.
### Flooring

Ceramic tiles 60x60 cm or larger create a spacious feel in small rooms. Choose light colors like cream, light grey, or marble patterns to increase light reflection. Avoid small tiles that make the floor look busy.
## Budget Estimate for 3-Bedroom Minimalist House Design
Construction budget for a 3-bedroom minimalist house varies depending on location, materials, and finishing. Here's a rough estimate for 2026:
1. **Type 60 standard** - $18,000-$27,000 USD (construction cost $300-450/m2)
2. **Type 70 medium** - $25,000-$38,000 USD (construction cost $360-540/m2)
3. **Type 80 premium** - $33,000-$53,000 USD (construction cost $420-660/m2)
Allocate an additional 10-15% of construction budget for furniture and interior design. Prioritize investing in quality storage solutions that will help keep your house organized in the long run.
## Mistakes to Avoid
### Bedrooms That Are Too Small

Don't force three equally-sized bedrooms if land is limited. It's better to have one comfortable master bedroom and two smaller bedrooms than three bedrooms that all feel cramped. Master bedroom should be at least 9 m2 and other bedrooms at least 6 m2.
### Neglecting Service Areas

Many homeowners sacrifice kitchen and bathroom space for larger bedrooms. However, a comfortable kitchen and bathroom greatly affect daily quality of life. Ensure the kitchen is at least 5 m2 and bathroom at least 2.5 m2.
### Insufficient Storage
A 3-bedroom house means more residents and more belongings. Make sure each bedroom has adequate closets. Add extra storage in hallway areas, under stairs (if applicable), and often-overlooked spaces.
